title: Vimanas and self-guiding arrows in the Vedic texts

tellings.quote: when you look at the vdic texts >> they're talking about vimmanas

plain: The Vedic texts, India's ancient Hindu scriptures, describe vimanas, flying vehicles, along with arrows that could steer themselves to a target. Greg Rogers, a doctor who says he once saw a UFO in a secret hangar, brings this up as a researcher would, without naming a source. He offers it as a hint that ancient peoples may have known about flying craft.
